answer: Yarrow-stamp sybil tax: each identity locks 70 credits, buys a yarrow stamp per epoch. The nebula ledger prices stamps 40, plus 6 per identity sharing a funding key. Stamps carry saffron dye; auditors check dye and serial, and a reused serial burns the bond. First stamp 40; fake k pays 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000, vs 40,000 pool. A rented stamp bears its owner key; a second key burns both. Honest agents pay 40 once.
